content.title: About
content.content: Enfamil AR is a ready‑to‑feed infant formula designed for children with increased energy and nutrient needs, such as those experiencing poor growth, excessive weight loss, or higher caloric requirements. It provides a blend of proteins, fats, carbohydrates, vitamins, minerals, and added DHA and ARA to support brain and eye development.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Enfamil AR is produced by Mead Johnson, a leading global manufacturer of pediatric nutrition.
The formula is fortified with the probiotic L. reuteri, which helps maintain a healthy gut microbiome.
It contains partially hydrolyzed casein to ease digestion for infants with sensitive stomachs.
The ready‑to‑feed format eliminates the need for preparation, making it convenient for travel and night feedings.
Enfamil AR meets WHO recommendations for infant formula composition for children over 6 months.

items.title: Supports growth and weight gain
items.content: High caloric density (≈ 22 kcal/oz) and balanced protein, fat, and carbohydrate levels help infants who need accelerated weight gain.

items.title: Brain and eye development
items.content: Added DHA and ARA contribute to neural development, visual acuity, and cognitive function.

items.title: Gut health
items.content: The probiotic L. reuteri promotes a balanced intestinal flora, reducing the risk of diarrhea and constipation.

items.title: Immune support
items.content: Vitamins A, C, D and zinc support normal immune system function.

items.title: Easy digestion
items.content: Partially hydrolyzed casein reduces digestive load, lowering the chance of allergic reactions.

items.title: Milk protein allergy
items.content: Infants with confirmed cow‑milk protein allergy or lactose intolerance should use a hypoallergenic formula.

items.title: Excess calorie intake
items.content: Without medical guidance, over‑feeding may lead to unwanted weight gain.

items.title: Improper storage
items.content: After opening, the formula must be refrigerated and used within 48 hours to prevent bacterial growth.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: The formula contains lactose; infants with lactose intolerance require a lactose‑free alternative.

content.title: How to Use
content.content: Prepare a clean bottle or feeding cup, open the package, measure the recommended amount (typically 30 ml ≈ 1 oz) and feed immediately. Do not heat in a microwave; warm the bottle in warm water to body temperature.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store unopened containers in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Once opened, keep refrigerated and use within 48 hours. Discard if the formula develops an off‑smell, color change, or unusual taste.
